forest-ink.$description: Forest Ink — All text, headings, and icon strokes — deep desaturated green replaces black throughout the entire interface, giving the system its organic technical warmth

emerald-pulse.$description: Emerald Pulse — Green supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color; Hero headline gradient flowing from forest green through emerald to amber — makes the display wordmark feel alive

pine.$description: Pine — Secondary brand green for darker button states, link text, and icon outlines when a heavier weight than Forest Ink is needed

mint-glow.$description: Mint Glow — Light accent green for secondary icons, decorative highlights, and hover state washes

jade-wash.$description: Jade Wash — Mid-green for outlined button borders, checkbox accents, and form focus rings

spearmint.$description: Spearmint — Lightest green for link hover states and subtle decorative washes

signal-red.$description: Signal Red — Red supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

lilac-whisper.$description: Lilac Whisper — Soft violet accent for the QStash product icon and category tags that need chromatic separation from the green family

snow.$description: Snow — Page canvas, card surfaces, and inverse text on dark code blocks

paper.$description: Paper — Subtle alternating section backgrounds and disabled control fills

pale-sage.$description: Pale Sage — Soft green-tinted surface for hero background washes and the gradient tail stop on decorative backgrounds

mint-mist.$description: Mint Mist — Lightest green-tinted background for announcement bars, tag pills, and the hero's left-edge gradient wash

hairline.$description: Hairline — Universal 1px border color for cards, inputs, dividers, and table rules — the most used color in the system

graphite.$description: Graphite — Muted secondary text, nav items, placeholder text, and subdued icon strokes

carbon.$description: Carbon — Darkest neutral for code block backgrounds and high-contrast borders where #000 feels too harsh

obsidian.$description: Obsidian — Code block background only — the single hard-black surface in the system

inter.$description: Body text, nav links, buttons, labels, and small UI chrome — the workhorse sans for everything below the heading level

inter-tight.$description: Display and heading face — the compressed cuts with negative tracking give headlines an engineered, dense quality; the 128px and 180px sizes create the signature 'loud whisper' hero moments where weight 600-700 meets extreme size with restraint

ui-monospace.$description: Code blocks and inline code — the slightly negative tracking tightens monospace characters for a cleaner, less typewriter-like read
